killedBy: verify.mjs: the seams no vitest run can execute installs the override on BOTH of its page paths, before either navigates
why: Leaves the two real `AudioContext`s the app builds at boot -- Howler's, when `createAudioEngine` first touches `Howler.volume()`, and `engine.ts`'s `ensureCtx`. On a host whose audio service never connects each constructor returns only after an internal 20-second timeout, so the page blocks for ~40 s before `load` fires and the clearance sweep's own context boots the app unguarded. This is ONE OF TWO page paths in this file and the other is guarded separately, so the failure is partial: the board sweep still runs and only the safe-area measurements time out.
